expected_structural_delta: No new allocator state or production module. Extend existing farm start dispatch and engine-only configuration.
minimum_design: Add opt-in queued pools that delegate one fresh count and retirement plan to the existing native capacity owner; start only returned sparse slots and close stopped-owner retry bypasses.
outcome: Dynamically size OS build classes while retaining active jobs and releasing idle specialized capacity.

reuse_decisions.name: native capacity owner
reuse_decisions.rationale: Do not add a competing shell allocator or idle removal path.

reuse_decisions.name: stable pool slot identities
reuse_decisions.rationale: Preserve busy high indices and start only exact selected free slots.
